create_DistillationHook: create a DistillationHook to run a teacher model in parallel with a student model for knowledge distillation
build_teacher_model: build a teacher model from config and initialize it with pre-trained weights for distillation
run_teacher_forward_pass: run a teacher forward pass to compute logits or prototypes and feed them to the distillation loss
shard_teacher_with_fsdp: shard a teacher model with FSDP to avoid GPU out of memory when using large models
sync_prototypes_to_student: sync teacher prototypes to the student model during IBOT distillation training
